title: 💰 A Huge Deal Shakes the Cybersecurity World!
body: 💰 A Huge Deal Shakes the Cybersecurity World!
Palo Alto Networks announced it is acquiring Applied Compute for $4.5 billion, paid entirely in stock.
The acquired company specializes in training and running open-source AI models, and its CEO will become a partner in leading AI inside Palo Alto.
Simply put, security companies are now racing to own AI tools, because the attacks themselves have come to rely on them.
Would you trust AI to protect your data? And why?
